description: Get one library entry: its metadata, versions and the agents, skills (with their bundle files as `{path, isText}`; `isText: false` is a binary file), MCP servers and files of its latest version, without their texts (read those with library_item). Item ids change with every published version. `entry` is the entry's exact name (matched case-insensitively, surrounding spaces ignored), or its id with `byId: true`; a value that looks like an id is still taken as a name without `byId`.

byId.description: `entry` is an entry id, not a name (CLI: --by-id).

entry.description: Library entry name, or its id with byId.

name: library_get
title: Get library entry
